scope: Raw VINS full-state drift measurement using the existing unarmed physical-support drift profile; measurement only, not a final accuracy qualification.

alignment.method: One raw VINS pose at the last source sample no later than one simulation second after the first stationary fixture trace sample.

truth.velocity_reference: Centered finite difference of independently recorded Gazebo truth position at the VINS source timestamp.
truth.base_to_imu_lever_arm_velocity_audit: Compute v_base from the truth sensor-origin trajectory and verify v_imu = v_base + omega_world cross r_world; compare VINS at the coincident IMU origin without applying the lever arm twice.

timing.sim_receipt_clock: ROS clock read at raw odometry subscription callback entry
timing.wall_receipt_clock: time.monotonic_ns read at raw odometry subscription callback entry
timing.receipt_gap: Difference between successive monotonic callback receipt stamps
